results.releaseNotes:
- Fixed Edit+Left/Right sample browsing from instrument screen failing for some samples.
- Fixed Edit+Left/Right sample browsing sort order not respecting file-browser sorting preferences.
- Fixed MIDI instrument notes not appearing on the right side info area.
- Removed restoration of the default library when users choose to delete content.
results.description:
M8 tracker is an eight-track music tracker, sequencer, and synthesizer from Dirtywave.

Create and arrange music using a portable tracker workflow. Sequences are built from phrases and chains, which can be arranged independently across eight tracks with sequencing and modulation at each step.

Instruments
• Wavsynth - Chip synth inspired wavetable synth 
• Macrosynth - Macro oscillators of over 40 unique synthesis engines
• FMSynth - Four-operator FM synthesis
• Hypersynth - Six-note 13 oscillator swarm synth
• Sampler - Sample playback and recording
• MIDI instruments for controlling internal or external gear
• Up to 128 instruments per song

Sequencing
• Eight independent monophonic tracks
• Instrument tables for advanced modulation
• Scales, grooves, probability, and comprehensive effect commands
• Live performance and song-rendering tools

Connectivity
• CoreMIDI input and output
• External computer keyboards and game controllers
• Launchpad Pro MKIII support
• Inter-App Audio (IAA) integration

M8 supports portrait and landscape orientations on iPhone and iPad. Projects, instruments, samples, themes, and rendered audio are accessible through the Files app. Built-in contextual help explains every view with shortcuts.

M8 for iOS provides the complete M8 workflow in a portable, touch-enabled interface. Songs and bundles are fully compatible with M8 hardware and can be transferred between devices and shared with other M8 users. Join the Dirtywave Discord community to share music, get help, and discuss M8.

results.releaseNotes:
Version 1.2.1
- Fix for EQ and Limiter view scopes drawing in the wrong place when in huge-font mode

Version 1.2.0
- Added high-resolution support for an improved iPad and screen-sharing experience.
- System settings are now stored per device, so sharing via iCloud no longer overwrites local theme and font preferences.
- Font settings can now be configured separately for portrait and landscape orientations.
- Fixed USB input while recording samples from a USB device.
- Fixed T1-T8 track recording in sample editor.
- File browser - Back shortcut (shift+left) did not scroll to top of list of parent directory.

Version 1.1.0
- AUv3 Plugin - Supports multi-channel and multi-instance
- Ableton Link support for sync (Not Link audio) - Located in the Project view right of tempo
- Custom M8 content locations (up to 16) can be added to the root file browser (including iCloud and Dropbox locations)
- Main M8 content folder can be defined, allowing the root content to be from another location (including iCloud and Dropbox etc) in System Settings
- Ableton Move as a Launchpad Pro MK3 control surface support added (Via Move Anything)
- Mic input now supports all available mics and mix modes while recording samples
- HOLD can now latch PLAY, allowing hands-free sample previewing. Hold now has swipe gesture support
- Multiple keyboard or controller buttons can now map to the same M8 control
- Lock screen playback controls now optional in System Settings

Improved
- Sampler recording now supports IAA and hosted audio input
- Standalone sampler input detection now distinguishes microphone and USB/line sources more reliably
- USB recording labels now use USB, U>L and U>R in standalone
- Broader iOS game-controller compatibility through physical controller profiles
- Sorting files in file browser - keep directories at top
